name: store_argument_in_returned_handle
description: Calls a library function and, if it returns a non-zero handle, stores the argument register value into a field at a fixed offset of that handle and then calls a second library function. It returns whether the first call produced a handle.

name: open_libraries_init_list_header
description: Opens two libraries in turn and, if both succeed, initialises an empty list header inside the structure passed in and returns that structure. If either open fails, it closes or frees what was obtained and returns zero.

name: close_library_and_free_block
description: Calls two library functions through the library base held in a global: one closes a library and the other frees a memory block. It then returns zero.

name: remove_idle_nodes_and_release
description: Walks a linked list and unlinks each entry whose counter is not positive, calling a library function on each removed entry. If no users remain, it closes two libraries, frees the structure and returns a saved value; otherwise it marks the structure as pending removal and returns zero.

name: close_and_free_when_idle
description: If the structure's usage counter is zero and its count field is not positive, it closes two libraries, unlinks the structure from its list, frees it and returns a saved value. Otherwise it sets a pending-removal flag and returns zero.

name: set_pending_removal_flag
description: Sets the top bit of a flag byte at a fixed field of the structure and returns zero. It only marks the structure, with no calls or other memory changes.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use. It performs no work.

name: clear_flag_and_increment_counter
description: Clears the top bit of a flag byte in the structure and increments a short counter at another fixed field. It then returns with no value.

name: decrement_usage_count_and_finalize
description: Decrements a short usage counter in the structure. When it reaches zero and the pending-removal flag is set, it calls a library function through the base and returns that result; otherwise it returns zero.

name: stub_return_zero
description: Routine that does nothing but return zero, with no calls or memory access. It is only reached from a tiny bitwise routine.

name: fill_font_entry_buffer
description: Fills a caller buffer with font entries: first one for each font in a linked list, copying its name and size and style fields, then, if the second flag bit is set, locks a directory and scans it with examine and next-entry calls. It returns how far the buffer overflowed, or zero.

name: append_list_font_entries
description: Appends an entry for each font in a linked list to a caller buffer and then, if the second flag bit is set, scans a directory for further matching files. It returns the buffer overflow amount, or zero when everything fitted.

name: split_names_into_font_entries
description: Walks a run of NUL-terminated names, adding an entry to a caller buffer for each completed name and advancing through a linked list. When the list ends it optionally scans a directory the same way as the other font-listing routines and returns the overflow amount.

name: build_font_names_from_dir
description: Copies characters into a name buffer and emits a font entry for each completed name. When the list is exhausted and the second flag bit is set, it locks the FONTS: directory and scans it with examine and next calls before returning the overflow amount.

name: collect_dot_font_files
description: Walks a directory listing, keeping each file whose extension matches the text ".font" and adding an entry for it to the caller's buffer. It closes the directory handles afterwards and returns the overflow amount.

name: emit_font_name_entries
description: Copies characters of a file name into a buffer and adds an entry for each completed name, repeating through the directory listing until it ends. It then closes the directory handles, releases the locks and returns the overflow amount.

name: read_font_file_entries
description: Reads a four-byte header from a file and checks it against a font-file marker. If it matches, it reads fixed-size 260-byte records and adds an entry for each name it contains, returning the overflow amount.

name: read_font_records_from_file
description: Reads fixed-size 260-byte records from an open file and adds an entry for each valid one until the file or its directory list is exhausted. It then closes the handles, frees the memory and returns the overflow amount.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Library code that returns zero and performs no operations on registers, memory or hardware.

name: compute_weighted_match_score
description: Compares two records plane by plane: it starts from a value derived from the difference of two short fields, then for each of seven bit positions where the records differ subtracts a weight from a table. It returns a fixed low value when the first record's short field is zero.

name: subtract_weighted_bit_mismatches
description: Starts from a value passed in a register and subtracts a table weight for each bit position where two records' byte fields differ, across seven positions. It returns the resulting score.

name: accumulate_bit_mismatch_weights
description: Resumes the bit-position scan with its state held in registers, subtracting a table weight for each differing bit until all seven positions are done. It returns the accumulated score.

name: scan_bit_positions_subtract_weights
description: Scans the remaining bit positions with the same weighting scheme, subtracting a weight when a bit is set in one of the two byte fields. It returns the score after seven positions.

name: return_constant_value
description: Library routine that returns a fixed negative constant without using any arguments or registers.

name: open_or_find_closest_font
description: Opens the font described by the parameter block and returns it directly when it is an exact match. Otherwise it searches a font file for the highest-scoring entry, links that entry into the font lists and returns the font handle.

name: search_fonts_dir_best_match
description: Locks the FONTS: directory, then reads a font file's header and fixed-size records and picks the record with the highest match score. It links the chosen record into the font lists, closes the handles and returns it, or zero if none fits.

name: select_best_font_from_file
description: Reads a font file's header and fixed-size records from an open handle and scores each record against the requested font. It links the highest-scoring record into the font lists, closes the handles and returns the chosen record.

name: link_highest_scoring_font_records
description: Repeatedly selects the record with the highest match score from a table and links each chosen record into the font lists. Once no candidates remain it releases the handles and returns the last record chosen.

name: add_best_font_records
description: Walks a table of font records keeping the best-scoring one, and for each selected record adds it to the font lists with list and font-add calls and a reschedule. It returns the last record added once no candidates remain.

name: pick_best_font_unload_segment
description: Selects the best-scoring record from a table and links it into the font lists, unloading a loaded segment after each selection. It repeats until no candidates remain, then releases the handles and returns the last linked record.

name: select_font_records_and_close
description: Repeatedly picks the highest-scoring record from a table and links it into the font lists, stopping when no candidate remains. It then closes the font handles, releases memory and returns the last record linked.

name: build_font_table_from_directory
description: Takes a font name, cuts it at its extension if that is the font extension, and locks the directory. It counts matching entries with examine and next-entry calls, allocates a table of records and fills each with its name and style fields, returning the table or zero.

name: load_disk_font_table
description: Counts directory entries with examine and next-entry calls, allocates a block sized for them and writes a header and count. It then copies each matching entry's name and style bytes into the table and returns the table pointer.

name: free_block_from_argument
description: Frees a memory block whose size is stored in its first word, by passing the block address and that size to the memory-free library call.

name: forbid_task_switching
description: Calls the exec routine that disables task switching, with no other work.

name: permit_task_switching
description: Calls the exec routine that re-enables task switching after a forbid, with no other work.

name: allocate_memory_block
description: Calls the exec memory allocation routine with its arguments and returns the block it provides. It performs no other work.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from a source string to a destination, one at a time, including the terminating zero.

name: append_null_terminated_string
description: Moves to the zero terminator of the destination string and then copies the source string onto that end, including its terminator.

name: skip_string_end_and_call
description: Advances a pointer to the zero terminator of a string and then passes that end position to the next routine. It performs no other work.

name: count_string_length
description: Counts the bytes before the terminating zero of a string and returns that count.

name: count_null_terminated_bytes
description: Increments a counter from the starting value while reading bytes through a string until a zero is read, then returns the total including the terminator.

name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte, returning -1 if the first is smaller, 1 if it is larger and 0 when they are equal.

name: compare_strings_stop_on_empty
description: Compares a string with a second string, returning zero straight away if the first string is empty. Otherwise it returns -1 or 1 according to the first differing byte.

name: compare_strings_from_registers
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings whose pointers are held in registers, returning -1, 1 or 0 for less, greater or equal.

name: find_character_in_string
description: Scans a zero-terminated string forward for the first occurrence of a given byte and returns its position, or null if the byte is absent.

name: find_char_with_register_argument
description: Scans forward through a zero-terminated string for a byte held in a register and returns the position of the first match, or null at the end of the string.

name: find_next_char_after_pointer
description: Starting one byte past a given position, scans forward for a byte held in a register and returns its position, or null when the string ends first.

name: find_last_occurrence_of_char
description: Measures a zero-terminated string and scans backward from its end for the given byte, returning the last matching position or null.

name: scan_backward_for_character
description: Moves backward from a position toward a limit, returning the first position holding the byte held in a register, or null if the limit is passed first.

name: find_char_backward_within_limit
description: Steps backward from a position for a byte held in a register, returning the first match, or null once the position passes the limit held in another register.

name: skip_past_path_separator
description: Returns a pointer just past the last directory separator or volume colon in a path, or the start of the path when neither is present.

name: increment_returned_value
description: Returns its input value incremented by one, with no other work.

name: forward_to_handler_routine
description: Calls a handler routine through a pointer stored in data and then returns. It performs no other work.

name: dispatch_to_external_handler
description: Calls an external routine through a stored pointer and returns, with no other operations.

name: call_next_routine_and_return
description: Calls another routine and returns straight away, doing nothing else.

name: pass_control_to_routine
description: Thin wrapper that immediately invokes another routine and then returns without any additional operations.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware use. The reference run reached it from outside the static flow, but it does no work.

name: copy_entries_and_call_handler
description: Copies sixteen longs from a fixed offset in a structure into the destination when one is supplied, then calls the function through the library base register and returns. It is only a copy-and-dispatch step.

name: run_program_with_buffer_setup
description: Finds the largest size value in a linked list of entries to size a working block, then writes a header and a run of words into it. It copies a template in and out around a library call, installs a local handler pointer, and returns zero on success or minus one when a required call fails.

name: copy_entries_and_call_handler
description: Copies sixteen longs from a fixed offset in a structure into the destination when one is supplied, then calls the function through the library base register and returns. It is only a copy-and-dispatch step.

name: run_program_with_buffer_setup
description: Finds the largest size value in a linked list of entries to size a working block, then writes a header and a run of words into it. It copies a template in and out around a library call, installs a local handler pointer, and returns zero on success or minus one when a required call fails.

name: copy_entries_and_call_handler
description: Copies sixteen longs from a fixed offset in a structure into the destination when one is supplied, then calls the function through the library base register and returns. It is only a copy-and-dispatch step.

name: run_program_with_buffer_setup
description: Finds the largest size value in a linked list of entries to size a working block, then writes a header and a run of words into it. It copies a template in and out around a library call, installs a local handler pointer, and returns zero on success or minus one when a required call fails.

name: copy_entries_and_call_handler
description: Copies sixteen longs from a fixed offset in a structure into the destination when one is supplied, then calls the function through the library base register and returns. It is only a copy-and-dispatch step.

name: run_program_with_buffer_setup
description: Finds the largest size value in a linked list of entries to size a working block, then writes a header and a run of words into it. It copies a template in and out around a library call, installs a local handler pointer, and returns zero on success or minus one when a required call fails.

name: copy_entries_and_call_handler
description: Copies sixteen longs from a fixed offset in a structure into the destination when one is supplied, then calls the function through the library base register and returns. It is only a copy-and-dispatch step.

name: run_execute_script_main
description: Entry routine of the Execute command: it allocates a context block, opens the script named on the command line and reads its lines through library calls, and writes a temporary command file when needed. It returns a failure code if the initial allocation or setup fails; the decompiler output stops partway, so later behaviour is not described.

name: parse_execute_directive_keyword
description: Reads the next token and maps it onto one of the directive keywords KEY, DEFAULT, BRA, KET, DOLLAR or DOT by a switch, storing the result in the context. It reports "Invalid directive" when the token matches none of them.

name: read_key_name_with_delimiters
description: Reads characters from the input line and collects a key name into a fixed buffer until a delimiter held in the context is reached. It reports "Key too long" when the name overflows the buffer.

name: read_single_character_token
description: Reads one token from the input and returns its first byte, but only when the token is a single character. A longer token is reported as an error through a routine.

name: check_single_character_argument
description: Checks that the current argument is exactly one character long, reporting "Invalid directive argument" otherwise. It then returns the character stored in the context.

name: select_stream_and_return
description: Calls two dos library routines through the context's base and returns, with no other work.

name: print_execute_prefix_and_cleanup
description: Shuts down one step of the Execute output: it closes any open stream held in the context, writes the "EXECUTE: " label when one is pending, and writes a newline before returning.

name: forbid_and_call_library_routine
description: Calls the exec routine that forbids task switching, then calls a second library routine through the same base, and returns.

name: store_registers_to_pointer
description: Stores the register values it is given into successive fields of the structure passed in, including the return address, then returns zero.

name: normalize_param_and_copy_word
description: Replaces a zero second argument with one, copies the first word of the structure into a location referenced by that structure, and returns the adjusted argument combined with a word from the structure.

name: divide_with_sign_handling
description: Divides one 32-bit value by another, delegating to other divide routines when either operand is negative and otherwise using a normalised shift-and-divide method. It returns the division result.

name: normalize_fixed_point_divide
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor using a normalised fixed-point method. It returns a 64-bit result with the quotient in the high half and the remainder in the low half.

name: run_logmerge_entry
description: Entry routine of the LogMerge command: it checks whether the first input byte is a special marker, runs setup and merge calls through the library base, and returns a failure code when setup fails.

name: release_resources_if_flagged
description: Calls five cleanup routines in turn, then one more only when a flag is set, and returns.

name: emit_log_entries_skipping_marker
description: Walks a table of log entries, skipping any entry that carries a particular marker value, and calls output routines for each remaining entry. An extra call is made when a specific character flags the entry.

name: accumulate_entry_counts_both_sides
description: Resets a counter, runs a counting routine over one list and adds its result to a running total. It does the same for the other list when a flag is clear.

name: merge_log_entry_tables
description: Merges entries from a source table into a destination table: each source entry is matched by key against the destination, updated when the newer values win, and appended otherwise. Output routines are called along the way.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies a zero-terminated string byte by byte into the destination, including the terminator.

name: write_block_checksum
description: Sums the words of a block after its first longword and stores the negated total, XORed with a fixed signature value, into that first longword.

name: verify_checksum_reset_records
description: Recomputes the checksum over a block and, when the total is non-zero, resets each record's default fields to fixed values.

name: xor_scramble_words_backward
description: Walks a block backward word by word, folding each word with its successor and a fixed key value, in place.

name: xor_scramble_words_forward
description: Walks a block forward word by word, replacing each word with a XOR of itself, the following word and a fixed key value, in place.

name: call_five_routines_in_order
description: Calls five routines in sequence and returns, with no other work.

name: call_routine_if_flagged
description: Calls one routine, then calls a second one only when a flag is non-zero, and returns.

name: forward_to_library_close
description: Passes control to the wrapper that closes a library and returns, with no additional operations.

name: parse_log_file_argument
description: Parses the log file argument: a leading at-sign marks an indirect form and a following S or s sets a flag. Otherwise it walks the name, skipping path separators and volume colons, and returns a failure code when the name is not valid; the default paths DF0 and DF1 are referenced here.

name: forward_to_logfile_handler
description: Passes control to the routine that handles the log file name and then returns.

name: copy_quoted_or_space_token
description: Copies one argument into a buffer, ending at a closing quote when the argument starts with a quote or at a space otherwise, and stops at a line end. It then zero-terminates the copy and returns zero.

name: scan_for_terminator_characters
description: Scans a string forward until it finds a character matching one of two register-held delimiters. It returns a failure code if a stop character appears first, and zero when the string ends without one.

name: return_failure_code
description: Returns a failure code of minus one together with its input argument, with no other work.

name: scan_pattern_with_stop_characters
description: Scans a string for one of two register-held characters, returning zero when a match is found first and minus one when a stop character appears first.

name: read_named_file_into_buffer
description: Locks a named file, examines its size, opens it and reads the whole file into a buffer. It then closes the handles and returns the buffer and its length.

name: write_buffer_to_named_file
description: Opens a named output file, writes the supplied buffer to it and closes it. It returns zero on success and minus one when the open fails.

name: write_string_to_output
description: Measures a zero-terminated string and writes it to the output stream through the dos write routine.

name: open_dos_library_handles
description: Opens the DOS library through the exec library, then fetches the standard input and output handles from it. It returns zero when all three succeed and one otherwise.

name: allocate_tracked_memory_slot
description: Finds a free slot in a small resource table, records the requested size there, allocates a memory block of that size and stores its address in the slot. The recorded size is cleared if the allocation fails.

name: free_all_tracked_memory
description: Walks the same slot table and frees each recorded memory block until an empty slot is reached.

name: run_program_with_buffer_setup
description: Finds the largest size value in a linked list of entries to size a working block, then writes a header and a run of words into it. It copies a template in and out around a library call, installs a local handler pointer, and returns zero on success or minus one when a required call fails.

name: copy_entries_and_call_handler
description: Copies sixteen longs from a fixed offset in a structure into the destination when one is supplied, then calls the function through the library base register and returns. It is only a copy-and-dispatch step.

name: run_iconx_program_entry
description: Entry routine of the IconX command: it reads its command-line options such as WAIT, WINDOW, DELAY and STACK, opens the icon and DOS libraries and a console window, and runs the icon's commands through a loop of library calls. It returns a status code.

name: forward_argument_to_library
description: Calls a library routine through the base with the argument it was given and returns, doing nothing else.

name: attach_allocated_entry_chain
description: If the current process has no attached structure, allocates one and records its size. It then walks a list of entries, allocating and chaining a node for each non-empty entry while task switching is forbidden, and returns the structure or zero.

name: format_output_via_table_entry
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer held in the global table, the formatting routine in this case, and returns.

name: copy_bytes_with_termination
description: Copies bytes from a source into a destination until a zero byte is read, then pads the rest of a counted field with zero bytes.

name: append_c_string_to_destination
description: Advances the destination pointer to the end of the existing string and then copies the source string onto that end, including its terminator.

name: compute_fixed_point_product
description: Multiplies two 32-bit fixed-point values held in registers by combining the cross terms of their high and low halves, and returns the 32-bit product.

name: run_loadwb_program_entry
description: Entry routine of the LoadWB command: it allocates a context block, splits the command-line text into arguments that honour quotes and escape codes, opens the icon and DOS libraries and waits on the message port for a reply. It then releases the context and returns its status.

name: release_process_state_and_return
description: Stores the given value into the current process context, then conditionally calls cleanup routines held there, such as closing a file, closing a library and freeing memory, before returning the stored value.

name: start_workbench_tool_from_args
description: Main worker of the LoadWB command: it makes sure the Workbench library is open, allocates a buffer and XOR-processes a global string with a fixed key, applied twice in the code. It then builds the tool's argument list and starts the tool through library vectors, reporting a missing resident tag or a failed start on error.

name: compare_strings_by_byte_order
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte, returning -1 if the first is smaller, 1 if it is larger and 0 when they are equal.

name: build_linked_list_from_table
description: Walks a table of entries, allocating a node for each one, copying its value into the node and linking the nodes into a new list. It returns the head of that list.

name: pad_release_field_on_match
description: Checks whether a version text matches the Workbench release 1.2 string and, if so, writes a dot and spaces into a fixed field of the buffer. Otherwise it only compares the text prefix.

name: write_dot_and_padding
description: Writes a dot followed by four spaces into fixed positions of a buffer.

name: match_prefix_against_global_text
description: Compares the start of a buffer with a fixed text byte by byte, advancing through both until the text ends or a byte differs, and returns with no value.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return with no operations, no calls and no memory access.

name: forward_with_stack_slot_pointer
description: Passes its two arguments on to another routine together with a pointer into the stack frame, then returns.

name: format_stack_text_and_forward
description: Calls the formatting routine through the global table, measures the length of the resulting stack buffer and passes the buffer and its length on to another routine when that length is non-zero.

name: store_byte_at_pointer
description: Writes one byte, held in a register, to the address held in a second register and returns.

name: validate_disk_block_bitmap
description: Main entry of the Disk-Validator command: it sets up a table of block records and walks the disk's allocation bitmap words, comparing two bit sets and counting mismatches in a running total. The decompiler output is cut off, so later behaviour is not described.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The bytes decode to an invalid instruction, so there is no routine here. It is only a halt marker for bad data in the keymap file.

name: build_level_type_name_table
description: Program entry that scans the level and type directories through the DOS library, copies each file name into fixed-size records, uppercases them and sorts the records to build a name table. The output is cut off partway through.

name: build_named_record_table
description: Builds a record table from a list of name pairs, copying each name into a fixed-size record and rewriting a Pa/ path prefix with a numbered digit. It returns the size of the table.

name: open_read_close_file
description: Stores two argument values, opens a file through the DOS library, then runs a further library call and closes the handle, returning the stored values.

name: open_read_close_file
description: Stores two argument values, opens a file through the DOS library, then runs a further library call and closes the handle, returning the stored values.

name: open_read_close_file
description: Stores two argument values, opens a file through the DOS library, reads from it and closes the handle, returning the stored values.

name: initialise_level_data_tables
description: Clears a large work table, fills numbered name strings, loads a resource through library calls and builds a string table from the result. The decompiler output is cut off partway through, so later behaviour is not described.

name: initialise_level_data_tables
description: Clears a large work table, fills numbered name strings, loads a resource through library calls and builds a string table from the result. The decompiler output is cut off partway through, so later behaviour is not described.

name: run_level_handler_entry
description: Entry routine of the level handler program: it finds its task, waits for and reads a message from its port, then initialises the level data tables with numbered name strings. It continues into level handling code that is cut off in the output.

name: setup_display_load_game_data
description: Sets up the display for the game: loads the data files through the DOS library, takes over the blitter and the display view, and programs the custom chip DMA and copper registers with interrupts disabled. It waits for vertical blank before returning.

name: shift_input_and_store_char
description: Clears a flag and, when the input value is not the escape code, shifts a 16-byte input buffer back by one place and stores the new character at the end.

name: clear_word_table
description: Zeroes thirty-two words of a global table one at a time and returns.

name: handle_control_key_codes
description: Checks the key code held in a register: a space or newline sets a state value and resets a counter, and four control codes each set a state byte and clear a related flag.

name: find_matching_name_entry
description: Walks a list of length-prefixed name records ending at a marker byte, comparing each name with a fixed string. On a match it copies the record's associated value into the global state and returns, stopping early when a flag is set.

name: forward_to_next_routine
description: Calls one routine and returns, doing nothing else.

name: reset_counter_and_run_callback
description: Calls one routine, clears a global counter, calls a second routine, then calls the function stored in a global pointer and returns.

name: reset_game_state_for_frame
description: Resets the game state tables and clears two word tables. It then runs a short loop that waits on a flag between steps, updates the frame counters, and programs the display list and background colour through the custom chip registers.

name: initialise_three_value_record
description: Fills a three-value record with default values where they are unset, then derives a third value from them by dividing a weighted sum by three. It writes a fixed pattern of four table entries at the end.

name: write_separator_and_global_byte
description: Writes a comma byte to an output pointer, then copies a global byte into two consecutive output bytes.

name: sort_records_write_commands
description: Fills a table of five-word records with their indices, sorts the records by their key fields using a compare-and-swap loop, then writes a fixed list of command bytes for each record followed by an end marker.

name: format_number_as_decimal_digits
description: Converts an unsigned value, capped at 99999, to decimal digits with leading zeros suppressed, and writes them to a string. A zero value writes a single zero digit.

name: format_four_digit_field
description: Writes a value capped at 9999 as four decimal digits, or four zero digits when the value is zero.

name: copy_twelve_byte_record_fields
description: Copies a twelve-byte table entry, selected by an index in a register, into two output locations: a long and a word into the first, and a long and a word into the second.

name: validate_state_and_poll_flags
description: Copies a seven-entry table with offset adjustments, then checks a set of register values against expected constants. When they all match it shifts a text buffer and polls a counter flag, returning one when the flag is set and zero when the counter runs out.

name: shift_text_buffer_on_marker
description: When the first byte of a 17-byte text buffer is an ampersand, shifts the buffer left by one place and zero-terminates it. The shift is applied twice in the code.

name: initialise_audio_and_copper_state
description: Clears a block of game state variables, programs the audio channel volumes and the copper and DMA control registers from configured values, then computes timing parameters and returns zero on success.

name: write_two_line_breaks
description: Calls a routine, writes a newline byte at one output position, calls it again and writes a second newline at another output position.

name: build_index_table_with_shuffle
description: Copies a list of words into an index table, subtracting a fixed offset and stopping at a sentinel. It then optionally reorders the table by swapping entries at computed positions and byte-swaps another table's words, and finally clears a 64-byte block.

name: skip_strings_by_offset_count
description: Computes a count from a scaled product of two globals, then skips over that many zero-terminated strings in a table and returns.

name: skip_strings_by_scaled_count
description: Computes a count from a global scaled by a second global, then skips over that many zero-terminated strings in a table and returns.

name: update_joystick_fire_state
description: Sets three colour register values depending on a delay counter, then checks the fire-button bits of the joystick port and advances a frame counter. It sets status bits when a position value passes two thresholds.

name: reset_game_counters_and_block
description: Clears two game counters and a 64-long block of state, then copies a saved value into a state word, calls a routine and clears a further flag.

name: wait_for_joystick_fire_states
description: Polls the joystick port's fire-button status bits in a loop, calling a sampling routine on each pass, until the expected combination of bits is seen. It returns the last sampled value.

name: poll_joystick_fire_until_ready
description: Repeats a sampling routine and reads a value until the port's fire-button bits show the ready state, then returns.

name: update_scroll_offsets_from_value
description: Derives several scroll-offset words from one byte value by duplicating its nibbles. It adds the value into two accumulators and sets two position words from it with fixed offsets added.

name: copy_or_fill_block_grid
description: For each active entry of a table, either copies a block of longs between two buffers or fills the block with a value, depending on a flag. It works on grids of eight by nine longs and waits for the blitter to finish.

name: adjust_value_while_stick_held
description: Derives a starting value from its argument, then loops while a stick or button condition holds, stepping the value up or down by one within a limit of one to 127. It returns the value shifted left by nine.

name: fill_pattern_table_with_marker
description: Fills a table of 127 longs with a pattern, substituting a second value at the index that depends on the argument. It then sets bits in a word computed from a stored value.

name: track_nearest_record_and_scroll
description: Scans a list of five-long records to find the one nearest the current position, switching the active record when a closer one is found. It then moves the scroll position toward the target in eight steps and reads the right and middle button status.

name: dispatch_game_command_code
description: Dispatches on a command code in a record: it stores or copies words into game tables, clears or copies state blocks, updates a record's name and position, and sets status bits from the joystick and button flags. It returns the value for the command.

name: spin_until_counter_wraps
description: Spins incrementing a global counter until it wraps to zero, repeating while its low bit is set, then returns.

name: spin_until_counter_wraps
description: Spins incrementing a global counter until it wraps to zero, repeating while its low bit is set, then returns.

name: wait_on_raster_counter_wrap
description: Spins incrementing a global counter until it wraps to zero with its low bit clear, acting as a timing wait on the raster position before returning.

name: wait_for_raster_match
description: Polls the raster position counter until it matches a value held in a register and its low bit is clear, then returns.

name: wait_for_raster_zero_bit
description: Polls a raster-driven global until it is non-zero with its low bit set, then returns.

name: wait_for_raster_byte_match
description: Waits until the raster position byte equals the low byte of its argument. When a high flag bit is set it first fetches the value through another routine, then returns.

name: run_game_frame_loop
description: Runs the main frame loop: each pass calls a set of update routines, decrements timers, advances game counters and checks the button and state flags. It returns when a sentinel, the timeout threshold or a button condition is reached.

name: clear_state_blocks_on_flags
description: Clears one or both of two 23-long state blocks depending on two flag conditions, setting a sentinel word in each block before clearing it. It calls a routine when neither flag applies.

name: advance_animation_frame_timer
description: Counts down an animation timer and, on reaching zero, reloads it and updates a state flag. It then copies the matching 13-long frame entry into the sprite record, or clears the record when a flag is set.

name: initialise_sprite_record
description: Fills an object record with the given position and pointer fields, sets a pointer offset derived from a count of at least ten, clears several fields and sets a fixed attribute word.

name: call_two_update_routines
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns.

name: test_point_inside_hit_regions
description: Tests a point against a table of rectangle entries. When it falls inside an active entry it advances that entry's counter, adds a value to the score field and records the hit in a list.

name: handle_keyboard_serial_input
description: Reads a key code from the keyboard serial register and decodes it. It toggles the pause and sound flags for two keys and sets command flags for a set of letter keys when the option state is active, then sends the keyboard handshake.

name: queue_blitter_copy_operation
description: When the flag bit is clear, selects a source block from a table, waits for the blitter to be free and programs its pointer, control, modulo and size registers to start a copy. It returns early while a counter has not run out.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no operations and no calls.

name: update_sprite_positions_with_clamp
description: Clamps two position values to a valid range, advances per-axis counters with wrap-around, and writes fixed colour and position words into the sprite table entries for each axis.

name: compute_clamped_sprite_coordinates
description: Scales two input coordinates by a factor, clamps them to a limit and derives shadow-style offsets. It stores the results either into the global state or into the record passed in, depending on which target is given.

name: process_active_entries_until_sentinel
description: Walks a ten-entry table, calling a pair of routines for each non-zero entry, and returns early when an entry holds the sentinel value.

name: test_box_and_nudge_position
description: Tests whether an entry's offset falls inside a bounding box and, when it does, subtracts a step value from a 32-bit position field.

name: test_box_and_advance_position
description: Tests whether an entry's offset falls inside a bounding box and, when it does, adds a step value to a 32-bit position field.

name: update_timed_spawn_entries
description: Walks ten 12-byte entries, clearing an entry whose cell is blocked and otherwise counting down its timer. When a timer expires it spawns a new entry into the first free slot of a list, copying its coordinates and setting its initial fields.

name: build_scroll_register_list
description: Writes a table of display-register words for a scrolling layer, advancing a phase value and polling a status bit between writes. It stops when the status bit clears and returns the final list word.

name: build_scroll_register_list_head
description: Returns straight away when a flag is zero; otherwise it builds a scroll register list in the same way as its neighbouring routine.

name: build_scroll_register_list_head
description: Returns straight away when a flag is zero; otherwise it builds a scroll register list in the same way as its neighbouring routine.

name: build_scroll_register_list_head
description: Returns straight away when a flag is zero; otherwise it builds a scroll register list in the same way as its neighbouring routine.

name: build_blitter_scroll_list
description: Advances a phase value and writes scroll list words into the blitter setup area while polling a status bit, then returns after the final write.

name: store_scaled_sprite_position
description: Looks up two table values by index and stores them scaled by eight into an object record, with an offset adjustment and a fixed constant added. It returns nothing.

name: compute_entry_position_or_clear
description: For an index within range, adds table-derived offsets to an object's position words and adjusts its vertical position, returning zero. Otherwise it clears the object's two position words and returns minus one.

name: update_moving_object_per_frame
description: Updates one moving object each frame: it checks timers and state flags, adjusts velocity and position, and calls other routines to spawn or refresh its entries. The decompiler output is cut off, so later behaviour is not described.

name: apply_velocity_by_direction_state
description: Clears a counter, then depending on a state byte either halves the velocity, negates it and sets a 50-frame counter, or flags a state. Otherwise it adds a table-derived velocity scaled by two.

name: step_positions_while_in_range
description: Returns when the timer is negative. Otherwise it moves two position values by fixed steps within limits, decrementing the timer on each step, and loops according to a state byte.

name: set_state_word_and_forward
description: When the state byte is two, stores the value fifteen into a word, then calls a further routine.

name: scan_until_routine_succeeds
description: Repeatedly calls a test routine while stepping an offset by a fixed amount for a bounded number of steps, and returns the pair of values once the test succeeds or the steps run out.

name: update_and_clamp_object_sprite
description: Returns if the entry is inactive. Otherwise it updates the entry's position from its velocity, clamps it to the play area and writes its sprite data words and blitter setup for display.
